name: SKILLUI
summary: Reverse-engineer any live site, git repo, or local codebase into a Claude-ready design system: colors, typography, spacing, animations, components, and screenshots in one command.
prevents: Inconsistent design systems, manually copying tokens from reference sites, agents guessing at colors and spacing.

cursor.rule_description: Use when a task requires matching an existing site's visual language, extracting design tokens from a URL or codebase, or bootstrapping a design system before building UI.
cursor.skill_description: agentgrammar SKILLUI — reverse-engineer any site or repo into a Claude-ready design system (tokens, type, spacing, animations, screenshots). Use when the user invokes /agentgrammar-skillui or needs to replicate a visual reference.
